## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] `check:treeshake` and `check:types` pass (components only)
- [ ] Looked at it in Storybook: light and dark, a seed colour, both motion schemes
- [ ] Accessibility: named controls, keyboard works, axe stories green
- [ ] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if a published package changed
- [ ] Updated `docs/COMPONENTS.md` if a component's status changed
- [ ] No hand-edits to `*.generated.*` files
